title: 7 New Aldi Finds Worth Adding To Your Cart This Week: Fall-Themed Throw Blankets, More - NewsBreak
text: Now that the summer is beginning to wrap up, certain stores are getting a head start on selling some of their fall items, and Aldi is one of them. In addition to some great finds that can make perfect everyday essentials, the affordable and popular grocery store has begun rolling out all sorts of different seasonal items that can take your fall to the next level. There’s a little something for everyone, with new products ranging from home decor to beauty essentials, yummy snacks , and more. If you’re ready to go shopping at Aldi in the next week and want to start slowly getting your fall shopping haul up and running, read more about the seven items we think you should add to your cart this week below. One of the best and most subtle ways to add a cute and trendy fall feel to your home once the weather starts to cool down is by introducing a pumpkin motif. Right now, Aldi is selling pastel and brightly colored pumpkins you can place in a vase or bowl for a touch of fall fun. For $4.99, you get a batch of six tiny, pastel-colored pumpkins that come in pink, blue, orange, and more. These little guys are great for transitioning from the summer to the fall and will make a super cute centerpiece in your home. Check them out for a bit of fall flair and get your hands on them before they're gone! Another way to mix things up at home is to swap out your candles . Lighting candles while hosting people or simply sitting in your living room and watching television can make a moment so much nicer. The Aldi Kirkton House brand has put out some new spa candles that are so nice that they will add a little luxury to your living spaces. They are releasing several new scents, including Grapefruit & Raspberry, Jasmine & Musk, and more, and you can get a large 12-ounce candle for only $5.99, so stock up while you can! They also make a sweet gift for anyone who could use a little more relaxation in their life. If you love a cup of tea and have been making them throughout your week without an electric kettle, no offense, but what are you doing? Avid tea drinkers need to get their hands on electric kettles, as they make prepping a mug of tea a whole lot easier. Now, you don't have to buy one at a fancy home goods store. You can get a pretty green-colored electric glass kettle for only $16.99. Once it's filled up, you simply flip a switch, and it'll start boiling your water. The glass body of the kettle also allows you to keep up with where your water is in the boiling process, if you want to cut it off a bit sooner. Who would've thought, in a world of high-tech hair styling tools and products , that rollers would make such a triumphant comeback? After all, some find that they really just work best. If you're looking for an effortless curl created using some hot rollers, Aldi is selling some from one of today's most popular beauty tool brands, Conair, for $14.99. The product is a kit of 10 compact rollers ranging in size, and they're perfect for using before a night out if you want some bouncy, curly locks. If you're ready for some fall flavors to start hitting your pantry again, then you're in luck, because Aldi has dropped some fall-themed snacks that look delicious. One of them is the bag of apple cinnamon-flavored yogurt-covered pretzels, which are an adorable sweet treat you can enjoy on their own or as part of a fall-themed snack mix. The pretzels are covered in an apple cinnamon yogurt coating, and Aldi is selling 7-ounce bags for only $2.99. You can eat them by the handful, enjoy them with some popcorn at the movies, include them in a gift basket, and more. The opportunities are endless. Just because these fall items are hitting shelves doesn't mean you can't enjoy the last bit of summer over the next week! One of the best ways to soak up the last summery moments is to pick a hot day, sit in a relaxing outdoor space, and enjoy a frozen cocktail or mocktail. Aldi is selling frozen Bellini mix, which is usually a cocktail that contains prosecco and white peach puree, with some delicious frozen fruit and no added alcohol. You simply add the frozen fruit package and some water to a blender for a tasty, refreshing frozen beverage. If you're hosting adults and want to make it a little boozy, you can add your liquor of choice. A bag is only $3.99 and makes for an awesome beverage option for closing out the summer weather. As the weather gets a little cooler, it's nice to have throw blankets in your home that you can snuggle up in while watching television or reading. If you're someone who loves to decorate for the fall and Halloween season early, then you'll love the cute and fuzzy throw blankets Aldi is rolling out. Each blanket is 50" x 60" and they come in super cute patterns, like black with little white ghosts, one with black cats and pumpkins, and more. If you don't want one for your home, they make a sweet gift for any Halloween lover in your life.
